_readme: Datadog log monitors for CustomerOps (COPS-07). Not imported yet. Each entry in `monitors` is a body for POST /api/v1/monitor. They read the structured lines that reportPlatformOpsMetrics writes every 10 minutes from the cops-onboarding-evaluator worker (fields: cops_metric, value, metric_status, runbook). Check the service name and the notification handles against the Datadog account before importing; they are placeholders taken from the log output of this repo.

monitors.name: [CustomerOps] A workflow health metric is critical: {{[@cops_metric].name}}
monitors.message: {{[@cops_metric].name}} is critical. The runbook path is in the `runbook` field of the log line; thresholds are in docs/ops/cops-alerts.md. @oncall-customerops

monitors.name: [CustomerOps] A workflow health metric is in warning: {{[@cops_metric].name}}
monitors.message: {{[@cops_metric].name}} has been in warning for three reports in a row. See docs/ops/cops-alerts.md. @slack-customerops-alerts

monitors.name: [CustomerOps] The health report has stopped
monitors.message: No CustomerOps health report in 30 minutes. The onboarding evaluator worker, Redis or the database is down, so the other CustomerOps monitors are blind. @oncall-customerops

monitors.name: [CustomerOps] The health report itself is failing
monitors.message: The CustomerOps health report threw twice in 30 minutes. Check the database and the worker logs. @oncall-customerops
